Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
 indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Mohamed Salah El Din Badawy, tested by eng. 
 Hassan Mohamed Amer,

 revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader EL Nagar, 
 and approved by eng. Mohamed El Sarag Damietta PS head sector
This document is 
 accepted

 coordinator, and certified by accountant; 
 Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Soliman;
 EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
Wear 
 standard personal safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, safety helmet, breathing mask, ... etc.
The unit must be out service.
Tools and Equipment
Megger (500 5000) volt.
Multimeter, Air blower, 
 Cleaning solvent
Complete maintenance tool set
Contact resistance tester.
Work to be Carried Out
Inspection Conditions
Be sure that the generator electrical and 
 mechanical isolated
Open the main hole and recover places from 
 generator
Dismantle the cover for generator bearing 
 from tow sides
Be sure that earthing switch connected and 
 put local earth
Isolated the potential transformer and 
 fuses
Be sure that the protection relays in 
 service

Stator 
Inspection
Clean the over hang for 
 end winding by using suitable cleaning solvent such as revolta
Inspect the over hang 
 and be sure that no cracks in insulation
Check the condition for 
 flexible joints
Check the outlet 
 generator bushing
Check the local earthing 
 points for generator body
